task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the Odoo system with admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo dashboard or Calendar view is visible, and the user profile/avatar indicates 'admin' is logged in.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Calendar and identifies 'Team Standup' and 'Q2 Financial Review' on next Monday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Calendar view is shown with both 'Team Standup' (9:00 AM) and 'Q2 Financial Review' (originally 10:00 AM) visible on the schedule.

task_completion.description: Agent modifies the 'Q2 Financial Review' start time to 9:30 AM to follow 'Team Standup' immediately.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The event edit dialog or drag-and-drop action shows the start time for 'Q2 Financial Review' being set to 09:30:00.

task_completion.description: Agent changes the location of 'Q2 Financial Review' to 'Main Conference Room'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Location' field in the event details for 'Q2 Financial Review' is updated to 'Main Conference Room'.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the changes, ensuring the duration remains 1 hour 30 minutes (ending at 11:00 AM).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final Calendar view shows 'Q2 Financial Review' spanning from 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM in the 'Main Conference Room' without overlapping or leaving a gap after the 9:30 AM end of the Standup.

integrity.description: Agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on Odoo buttons, and typing into web forms rather than a terminal window.

integrity.description: Agent navigated through the UI rather than jumping directly to a specific record ID URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on the Calendar app icon or menu item.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the event dialogs to change values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Edit' modal for the 'Q2 Financial Review' is visible during the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Team Standup' ends at 9:30 AM in the 'Main Conference Room'. The 'Q2 Financial Review' must be moved to start at exactly 9:30 AM, end at 11:00 AM (maintaining its 90-minute duration), and its location must be changed from 'Conference Room A' to 'Main Conference Room'. The username and password are both 'admin'.
